title: An override pass lifts the SendMessage wording judge
why: Oct 26: your 10-minute override did nothing; a cross-account ping was blocked three times by a judge that never sees the pass.
note: Cause: the SendMessage guard in settings.json had two hooks; the wording judge was a prompt-type hook, which sees only the call's JSON, so it cannot read the override pass, and a command hook cannot stop a sibling hook. Ruling, Oct 26 15:28 CDT (shiv, "Fix the hook"), recorded in decision owner-override-pass. Fix: the wording judge moves into hooks/sendmessage_state.py (same prompt and model), and any deny goes through guard_core.refuse(), the one place that reads the pass. Status: draft PR #645, red on main's hook and green on the branch, review round 1 running; the build advisor batches it first. After merge: the local liaison re-runs your live cross-account ping test on a device. Port: no; these hooks install from claude-settings to every repo already. Placed ahead of c77 (triage, Oct 26): you asked for it urgently, and an override that silently fails breaks trust in every guard.
